We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (result of make_5_lvl2-template_search-2) to the molecule. We have from make_5_lvl2-template_search-2 answer: a dict with 'mapped_rxn' and 'template_id': 12345. So template_id = 12345. We need to apply this template to the target molecule. What is the target molecule? It should be from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 answer: a list of SMILES strings? That answer gave three SMILES strings each inside inner list? Actually answer: 
[["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"], ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"], ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"]]

These are three possible target molecules? Actually they are likely the product molecules? The task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below". The molecule below is likely the one from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1? That answer gave three SMILES (maybe three possible products). But we need to apply the template (id 12345) to each of those molecules to get precursors. So we need to call apply_template for each SMILES with template_id 12345.

Let's do that.
